Status: Destroyed. This entry is lore/reference only — Cardinal Monçada is not a playable or usable Storyteller Actor, as he no longer exists in the setting's present night.

The mastermind of Clan Lasombra has been destroyed. For nearly a thousand years he led much of his clan and sect toward a vision of Cainite mastery under the banner of Heaven's wrath, originating many policies that still define the Lasombra's Final Nights position, including rapid New World expansion and frontier brood havens.

He was destroyed when an Abyssal guardian, long ago set to protect his innermost sanctum in Madrid, turned on him during an Assamite attack — for reasons survivors don't fully understand. His ruined Madrid haven is now a Lasombra pilgrimage site, protected by a small elder coterie.

His childe, Lucita, took part in the Assamite assault that destroyed him. His destruction spurred widespread abandonment of the Righteous Path of Night variant, which he had championed (see Path of Night: Variants).
